title: Posting Carrier Payments to Mold Remediation Jobs
content:
The job must be in remediating, awaiting clearance, cleared or invoiced status when insurance proceeds are posted. The carrier payment must be recorded on the same claim file this job is linked to. Only dwelling-coverage carrier payments the company has received directly, or by a two-party check the insured has endorsed, are posted to a Mold Remediation job. A carrier payment is posted to the same mold job at most once.

The amount posted is the least of three figures:

1. the job's balance due;
2. the carrier payment's unapplied remainder after every posting already made from it to any water, fire, mold or rebuild job;
3. the claim file's mold sublimit less the insurance proceeds already posted to mold jobs of that claim file.

Jobs sharing one carrier payment are paid in the order of the claim payment allocation rule of the Insurance Claim Services charter.

## Checks made on the records

| Check | Record | Must show |
|---|---|---|
| Job status | The mold job | Remediating, awaiting clearance, cleared or invoiced |
| Same claim file | The carrier payment on the Insurance Claim Services file, and the mold job's linked claim file | The same claim file |
| Kind of payment | The carrier payment | Dwelling coverage, received directly or by an endorsed two-party check |
| Not already posted | The mold job's insurance postings | No earlier posting from this carrier payment |

## Worked example (hypothetical)

A mold job shows a balance due of 3100.00. The carrier payment it draws on was 8000.00, of which 5900.00 has already been posted to a water job, leaving 2100.00. The claim file's mold sublimit is 5000.00 with 1700.00 already posted to another mold job, leaving 3300.00. The amount posted is the least of 3100.00, 2100.00 and 3300.00, which is 2100.00.
